item.title: Lenovo Legion Go Beam: Affordable Handheld Gaming PC
item.description: Lenovo’s leaked Legion Go Beam promises a handheld gaming PC, retaining familiar grips while slashing ports and price to undercut $1k‑$2k rivals.
